description: CAP在Qwen、Gemini、GPT-4o、GPT-o1上均提高SA与PC ROC-AUC。

name: prompt_variation
description: Physics-enhanced prompt对7个开源模型均高于Event；Detailed并非一致提高。

name: model_scale
description: 同架构的Cosmos 14B/7B与CogVideo 5B/2B作规模对照，整体指标多为大模型略高。

name: erratic_change_pairing
description: abrupt成功53/240，non-abrupt 101/240；Pika为6/20与15/20。

name: scene_complexity_pairing
description: complex成功28/240，less-complex 44/240；Pika为3/20与8/20。

name: component_deletion
description: No removal of Trajectory, Action classes, Observation classes, validation, or either conversion stage.

name: hyperparameter_scale_sensitivity
description: No sensitivity analysis for w_d, optimizer, epochs, or model-training hyperparameters.

name: data_task_heterogeneity
description: Table 6 compares task-specific data with an ADP mixture in five configurations.

name: mechanism_alternative_data_volume
description: Table 10 matches approximate 30K sample scale to test the data-volume alternative.

name: failure_cases
description: No trajectory conversion or agent-behavior failure-case analysis is provided.

name: compute_cost
description: LOC is analyzed as integration cost; model training compute cost is not reported.

name: robustness
description: Equal-scale comparison is the only explicit robustness control.

name: applicability_boundary
description: Harness-specific domain filtering defines what data each agent actually consumes.

name: naive data extraction
description: Default pretty-printing, no premise blacklist, and no premise collection from simp/rw calls reduce recall and especially settings using Lean-auto.

name: negative premise sampling
description: Setting B−=0 lowers recall@16/32 from 61.1/71.9% to 51.8/59.5% and full proof rate from 34.6% to 33.0%.

name: positive masking in loss
description: Removing masking lowers recall and each individual proof setting, while cumul rises to 38.4%; the authors attribute the isolated rise to random noise.

name: seed/repeated-run and sensitivity analysis
description: No repeated seeds, variance table, or sensitivity curve is in the PDF; k tuning and extra results are referred to the external extended version.

name: gradual_sharding
description: Scale sensitivity/robustness: vary shard count from 1 to 8 while holding the underlying problem fixed.

name: recap_and_snowball
description: Mechanism alternative: repeat all requirements once or cumulatively to test whether context reminders recover performance.

name: system_prompt_hint
description: Behavioral intervention: tell GPT-4o that the user may initially omit needed information.

name: temperature
description: Randomness sensitivity: vary assistant and user temperature over 0, 0.5, and 1.

name: episodic_translation_negative_result
description: Scope/negative result: an append-style translation task does not degrade under SHARDED.

name: qualitative_mechanism_analyses
description: Four observational analyses target premature answering, answer bloat, turn-position attention, and verbosity.

name: component_deletion
description: The work proposes an evaluation environment rather than a trained modular model, so there is no learned component-deletion ablation.

name: compute_cost_analysis
description: Main simulation cost is estimated at $5,000; sharding preparation requires about three author-hours per 100 instructions.

name: empirical ablations and negative-result suite
description: 没有训练、数据或可删除组件；A.2 的 gadget decomposition 是 correctness construction，不是 ablation。
